component.name: Pomotroid
component.summary: Configurable Pomodoro timer with themes and session statistics

description.p: Pomotroid tracks work sessions and breaks using the Pomodoro Technique, with configurable durations, themes, sound alerts and session statistics.
This community package installs the official upstream Debian build unmodified. Tray support includes the Ayatana libraries.

To disable automatic in-app update checks, open Settings, select System, and turn off "Check for Updates Automatically". Update this package through Flatpak; the in-app setting does not disable Flatpak updates.

The optional WebSocket server and online update checks need network access, disabled by default. Enable it with flatpak override --user --share=network com.splode.pomotroid. Undo with flatpak override --user --unshare=network com.splode.pomotroid. Update the application through Flatpak.
